title: The Hat Blown onto the Rosemary
youtube_title: The Hat Blown onto the Rosemary | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness is helping carry what feels too heavy.
summary: At a cottage porch and the hall just inside, a hat resting in the rosemary, unharmed is awkward for one person. Yuri notices Cousin Pio struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
